# Responsive navigation and theme capture

Captured from the built website with Playwright Chromium at 390 × 844 CSS pixels.

- `before-mobile.png` shows the three-row wrapping navigation and cropped left rail.
- `after-mobile.png` shows the compact header and the full 16:9 Neon City capture.
- `after-keyboard-open.png` shows the native menu expanded and the current Themes link highlighted after keyboard activation.

The same page was checked at 390, 768, and 1280 pixels. Document width matched viewport width at each size. The mobile menu is shown through 960 pixels; the full navigation remains on one line at 1280 pixels.
